name: Decomposed Low-Rank Tensor (VM-Decomposition)
aliases: Tensorial Scene Representation with Vector-Matrix Factorization
definition: Scene representation using decomposed low-rank tensors for density and color fields, specifically VM-decomposition.
summary: Decomposed Low-Rank Tensor factorizes 4D scene tensors into vector and matrix factors to reduce memory and accelerate training, distinguishing itself by relaxing low-rank constraints for two tensor modes unlike CP-decomposition.
